counterfactual.change: halved dt from 0.0302258 to 0.015, keeping steps=9 and all else same; finer substepping resolves close encounter and conserves energy within threshold

explanation: Bodies 3 and 4 (m~15.7 and 10.5) have a close encounter with softened distance dropping to 0.40 at step 9, comparable to softening 0.3. Potential deepens from -804 to -1412 and kinetic surges from 586 to 1247 in one outer step with only 6 substeps at dt=0.0302. Leapfrog under-resolves the strong acceleration, causing total energy to jump from -217.3 to -164.49, exceeding the 2% allowed change.
vision_note: Two large blue bodies in the upper left cluster start separated in steps 6-7 and rapidly converge through step 8. By step 9 they overlap almost completely as one is slingshotted, indicating a very close encounter with strong acceleration and a sudden velocity kick.
